links.outcome: AI diet plan nutrient content versus dietitian reference and adolescent guidelines
links.effect: AI systematically undercalculated energy (bias +695 kcal), protein (+19.9 g), lipid (+15.8 g), carbohydrate (+114.6 g); protein 21.5-23.7% and lipid 41.5-44.5% above guidelines, carbohydrate 32.4-36.3% below.
links.quote: AI models have exhibited clinically significant deviations in diet plans for adolescents at both macro and micro levels.

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-generated diet plan nutrient content against dietitian reference standard
links.effect: Significant variation between models in micronutrients; no model consistently close to the dietitian across all nutrients; energy and macronutrients undercalculated.
links.quote: Significant variation was observed between models in micronutrient contents, and no model showed consistent proximity to the dietitian across all nutrients.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and clinical validity of diet plans generated by multiple LLM tools for standardized adolescent profiles compared to dietitian plans; does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
